name: claude-motion
display_name: Claude Motion — Premiere Pro & After Effects
description: Edit in Adobe Premiere Pro and animate in After Effects by chatting with Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Claude Motion panel inside Premiere Pro and After Effects. Claude can read your active sequence or comp and run edits live: cuts, markers, transitions, sequences, titles, keyframes and expressions. Requires the Claude Motion CEP panel (https://github.com/HimanProgrammer/claude-motion) to be open in the Adobe app.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Which Adobe apps have the Claude Motion panel connected

tools.name: get_project_state
tools.description: Active comp (After Effects) or sequence (Premiere) as JSON

tools.name: run_extendscript
tools.description: Run an ExtendScript edit live in Premiere Pro or After Effects

port.title: Bridge port
port.description: Local port shared with the Claude Motion panel. Leave as 8765 unless you changed it.
